# RMIT University Vietnam

> RMIT University Vietnam offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and pathway programs across business, technology, and creative industries with global study opportunities and comprehensive student support services.

RMIT University Vietnam is a leading international university campus in Ho Chi Minh City offering Australian-accredited degrees, English language programs, and pathways to further study. The institution provides access to RMIT's global network including campuses in Melbourne, Australia and Europe.

## Academic Programs

- [Study at RMIT](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/study-at-rmit): Overview of RMIT Vietnam study programs and degree recognition.
- [Study Areas](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/study-at-rmit/study-areas): RMIT Vietnam programs in business, technology, and creative industries.
- [Undergraduate Programs](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/study-at-rmit/undergraduate-programs): 17+ undergraduate degree programs at RMIT Vietnam.
- [Postgraduate Programs](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/study-at-rmit/postgraduate-programs): Postgraduate and MBA programs at RMIT Vietnam with scholarships.
- [Pathway Programs](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/study-at-rmit/pathway-programs): Foundation and English pathway programs for university preparation.
- [English Language Programs](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/study-at-rmit/english-language-programs): English language courses for university and general proficiency.

## Student Resources & Support

- [Current Students](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/students): Resources for current RMIT students including Canvas, library, and career development.
- [Student Life](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/student-life): Campus community, clubs, sports, and student support services.
- [The RMIT Vietnam Library](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/libraryvn): RMIT Vietnam Library with 700,000+ books, journals, and library services.

## Admissions & Financial Information

- [International Students](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/study-at-rmit/international-students): Study information for non-Vietnamese passport holders at RMIT.
- [Scholarships](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/study-at-rmit/scholarships): Scholarship and financial aid opportunities at RMIT Vietnam.
- [Tuition Fees](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/study-at-rmit/tuition-fees): RMIT Vietnam semester tuition fees and payment information.
- [Important Dates](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/study-at-rmit/important-dates-for-students): 2025 academic calendar and key dates for RMIT students.

## Global Opportunities

- [Global Experience](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/study-at-rmit/global-experiences): Study abroad and transfer opportunities to RMIT Melbourne.
- [Study at RMIT Melbourne](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/study-at-rmit/study-at-rmit-melbourne): Study opportunities at RMIT Melbourne campus in Australia.
